questionText: Sum and Difference of two expressions are 5a²−a−4 and a²+9a−10 respectively. Their LCM is:
hints: The two expressions: E₁=(S+D)/2, E₂=(S−D)/2.
LCM: take highest power of each factor. Coefficient LCM(2,3,4)=12. Variables: (x+1)(x+2)(x−2).
Move the constant to the other side first.
When you move −7 to the right side, it becomes +7.
After that, divide both sides by the coefficient of x.

misconceptions.A: Recheck your steps — move constants first, then divide by the coefficient.
misconceptions.C: Check if you moved the constant term to the other side before dividing.
misconceptions.D: You may have forgotten to divide by the coefficient of x in the last step.
